propositions: The outbound differ compares fields in vendor shape while the inbound differ compares in canonical shape, creating an asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d) canonical-comparison principle.
The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot via injected InboundMapper before field comparison, mirroring the inbound differ's approach.
Field comparison helpers must move to canonical (local) vocabulary in core, with vendor-shaped payloads built only at emission boundaries via OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote.
InboundMapper output must be widened with canonical aliases (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) to enable neutral field comparison without vendor-specific knowledge in core.

The stored arbitration baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest but must be canonicalized at read time via map_remote_to_local, which must tolerate partial _BASELINE_FIELDS subsets by emitting only keys whose vendor source is present.

Assignee resolution and the _assignee_is_account_id sentinel must be re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee, parameterized only on canonical identity shape, preserving the existing 3-state contract for dispatch_one.py downstream.
